plugins.name: core-coding-standards
plugins.description: Universal code quality rules — KISS, DRY, clean code, code review. Base skill every project should include.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree.

plugins.name: lang-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript language patterns and type safety rules — strict mode, no any, discriminated unions.

plugins.name: platform-frontend
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic frontend architecture — state management, components, data fetching.

plugins.name: platform-backend
plugins.description: Server-side architecture and security — API design, error handling, validation, logging. Use when building APIs, server logic, or reviewing backend security.

plugins.name: platform-database
plugins.description: SQL database design, query optimization, and migration safety.

plugins.name: platform-testing
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic testing principles — test philosophy, structure, mocking boundaries.

plugins.name: platform-cli
plugins.description: Design and implementation patterns for building command-line tools with modern UX.

plugins.name: tech-react
plugins.description: React 19 patterns for components, hooks, Server Components, and data fetching with Suspense.

plugins.name: tech-trpc
plugins.description: tRPC router architecture, procedure design, and Vertical Slice Architecture patterns.

plugins.name: tech-drizzle
plugins.description: Drizzle ORM schema design, relational queries, and migration patterns.

plugins.name: tech-vitest
plugins.description: Vitest-specific testing utilities — vi.mock, vi.fn, fake timers, MSW.

plugins.name: design-frontend
plugins.description: Visual design system patterns for web UIs — layout, responsive, Tailwind tokens.

plugins.name: design-accessibility
plugins.description: WCAG AA and ARIA best practices — screen readers, keyboard navigation, focus management.

plugins.name: figma-to-react-components
plugins.description: Convert Figma component designs into production-ready React implementations with design token integration, accessibility via React Aria, and comprehensive documentation. Use when building React components from Figma designs, generating component implementation specs, or bridging design-to-development workflows.

plugins.name: liquid-glass-ios
plugins.description: Apple's Liquid Glass design system for iOS 26+ and iPadOS 26+.

plugins.name: swift-concurrency
plugins.description: Swift Concurrency patterns — async/await, actors, tasks, Sendable conformance.

plugins.name: promptify
plugins.description: Transform user requests into detailed, precise prompts for AI models.

plugins.name: agent-add-rule
plugins.description: Add rules, conventions, or instructions to the project's agent configuration.

plugins.name: agent-init-deep
plugins.description: Initialize or migrate to nested CLAUDE.md structure for progressive disclosure.

plugins.name: agent-skill-creator
plugins.description: Guide for creating effective, portable skills that extend Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, and tool integrations.

plugins.name: agent-pr-creator
plugins.description: Analyzes git diffs and commit history to intelligently fill PR templates and create pull requests via gh CLI. Use when user wants to create a PR, needs PR description help, or says 'create a pull request', 'fill PR template', 'make a PR', 'open a pull request', or mentions PR creation.

plugins.name: localize-ios
plugins.description: Localizes UIKit Views and ViewControllers and SwiftUI Views. Extracts hardcoded text, generates camelCase keys, replaces literals with String(localized:) or LocalizedStringKey, and creates or updates Localizable.xcstrings.

plugins.name: tech-android
plugins.description: Android and Kotlin development patterns — Compose, architecture, coroutines, Room, navigation, Hilt.

plugins.name: rewrite-commit-history
plugins.description: Rewrite a feature branch's commit history into clean conventional commits.

plugins.name: pr-comments-address
plugins.description: Reads open review comments from a GitHub PR, triages them, applies code fixes, and drafts reply messages. Use when user wants to address PR comments, says 'address review comments', 'fix PR feedback', 'handle PR comments', 'respond to review', or mentions addressing code review feedback on a pull request.

plugins.name: type-system-audit
plugins.description: Audit type-system weaknesses using bug-fix commits as evidence

plugins.name: transcript-notes
plugins.description: Process meeting transcripts into structured notes with metadata, TL;DR, key topics, action items, and quotes

plugins.name: eval-agent-md
plugins.description: Behavioral compliance testing for any CLAUDE.md or agent definition file. Auto-generates test scenarios from your rules, runs them via LLM-as-judge scoring, and reports a compliance score with per-rule pass/fail breakdown. Optionally improves failing rules via automated mutation loop.

plugins.name: parallel
plugins.description: Run a task in a background sub-agent so you can continue working on other things.

plugins.name: ts-linter
plugins.description: Set up and enforce a strict, production-grade ESLint configuration for TypeScript projects, then systematically fix all linting issues.

plugins.name: bug-report-gen
plugins.description: Draft, evaluate, enrich, and normalize QA bug reports to RAVN standards. Trigger on "write/create a bug report", "I found a bug", "log this defect", "evaluate/score/review/improve my bug report", "normalize these bug reports", or when a user describes unexpected behavior. Also triggered by /bugreport.

plugins.name: locators-scanner
plugins.description: Scan a website URL and extract the best locators for every visible element on the page, outputting a Page Object Model (POM) code file and/or a JSON locator map tailored to a specific test automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or WebdriverIO). Use when users say "scan this page for locators", "extract locators from URL", "get selectors from website", "generate page object from URL", "build POM from page", "find locators for this URL", "what locators should I use for this page", "scan this page for elements", "extract selectors", "generate locator map", "get element selectors for testing", or mention scanning/extracting locators from a website. Also trigger when a user pastes a URL and asks to generate a page object, locator map, or selectors for Playwright, Cypress, or WebdriverIO. Also explicitly triggered by the /locators command.

plugins.name: test-case-gen
plugins.description: Generate, evaluate, audit, and normalize QA test cases to RAVN standards. Trigger on "generate/write/create test cases", "evaluate/score my test cases", "audit my test suite", "review test coverage", "normalize/reformat test cases", or when a user wants test design help. Also triggered by /testcases.

plugins.name: test-plan-gen
plugins.description: Generate professional QA Test Plan documents (.docx or .pdf) from a structured interview. Trigger on "create/write a test plan", "I need a test plan", "prepare QA documentation", /testplan, or when a user uploads a PRD/requirements and wants a test plan generated.

plugins.name: design-variations
plugins.description: Generate a gallery of design variations for a UI component. Takes an existing component (by name, code, or screenshot) and produces N distinct rendered alternatives in a single HTML comparison page.
